books.title: Healing Through the Akashic Records: Using the Power of Your Sacred Wounds to Discover Your Soul's Perfection
books.author: Linda Howe
books.description: Her guide to working with painful experiences, which she calls sacred wounds, inside the Akashic Records through the Pathway Prayer. It sets out a three-step process for gaining a soul-level view of a difficulty and turning it into practical choices.

courses.title: Akashic Records Level II: Advanced Healing Practitioner
courses.description: The second recorded certification class in her method: twelve sessions on spiritual healing in the Records, self-love as a practice and making peace in relationships. It follows Level I and draws on her book Healing Through the Akashic Records.

flags: Book ASIN 1622036042 from the amazon.com link on her own book page (lindahowe.com), not confirmed elsewhere; Sounds True paperback, revised 2016.
Level II price: $650 as on her bundles page; the Learn It Live page shows $650 and a lower $585. 'Healing' here is spiritual healing of emotional wounds; no claim to treat a condition.
